whyGold.title: A hedge against inflation
whyGold.description: When prices rise, the rupee buys less — but gold has historically held its purchasing power. Money parked in gold tends to keep pace with the cost of living in a way idle cash cannot.

whyGold.title: The classic safe haven
whyGold.description: In times of market turmoil, currency weakness, or global uncertainty, investors move to gold. It has held value through wars, recessions, and crashes for centuries.

whyGold.title: Always liquid
whyGold.description: Gold is one of the most liquid assets in India — instantly understood, easily valued, and convertible into cash, coins, or jewellery in any town, at any time.

whyGold.title: True diversification
whyGold.description: Gold often moves differently from shares, mutual funds, and fixed deposits. A gold allocation cushions your overall savings when other investments dip.

whyGold.title: Part of every Indian milestone
whyGold.description: Weddings, births, festivals — gold is the one asset that is also a gift, an heirloom, and a tradition. What you accumulate today becomes tomorrow's celebration.

whyGold.title: Effortless in digital form
whyGold.description: No lockers, no purity worries, no minimum of a full coin. Digital gold lets you build your holding from ₹100 at a time, secured against your account until you redeem.

features.title: Start from just ₹100
features.description: Buy 24K digital gold in fractional grams — no minimum grams, no fixed schedule. Invest any amount, any day. 3% GST applies on the purchase value.

features.title: Live market rate
features.description: Every purchase is executed at the day's published gold rate, so you always know exactly how many grams you own.

features.title: Secured in your account
features.description: Your gold balance is recorded against your KYC-verified account — track your invested amount, purchase rate, and current value any time.

features.title: Redeem coins or withdraw cash
features.description: After 11 months, redeem your accumulated gold as gold coins (1% making charge at closure) — or, if you prefer not to take coins, withdraw the equivalent value in money.

steps.title: Create your account
steps.description: Complete KYC with your Aadhaar, PAN, email and mobile number. Our team verifies and activates your account within 24 hours.

steps.title: Invest
steps.description: Buy any amount from ₹100 upward, plus 3% GST. Your grams are credited at the day's rate.

steps.title: Redeem after 11 months
steps.description: Track your holdings in your dashboard. After 11 months, close the scheme and redeem as gold coins (1% making charge) or withdraw the equivalent value in money.
